description: FreeSurfer fsaverage template subject: pial surfaces, Desikan-Killiany parcellation (aparc.annot), and aseg.mgz subcortical segmentation. Used to build all 3D geometry and the atlas region table.
license: FreeSurfer license terms; redistributed as part of the MNE-Python fsaverage dataset bundle
derivedArtifacts: data/atlases/atlas.dk.json (region table from annot color table + aseg labels)
limitations: fsaverage is a population-average template; it does not represent any individual brain.
Decimation (~9x) smooths fine gyral detail; region boundaries are approximate at mesh edges.
Region labels on decimated vertices were transferred by nearest-neighbor from the full-resolution surface.
